label: Vertical managers
instructions: Are vertical cable managers mounted along the side of the rack?
true_description: A vertical manager, finger duct, or side trough is mounted on the rack.
false_description: The visible rack side has no vertical cable manager.

label: Horizontal managers
instructions: Are horizontal cable managers visible between pieces of equipment?
true_description: A horizontal manager or bar is mounted between equipment units.
false_description: Equipment is stacked with no horizontal cable manager between the units.

label: Cables in managers
instructions: Do the visible data or power cables run through a manager, raceway, or finger duct?
true_description: Visible cables pass through a manager, raceway, or finger duct.
false_description: Visible cables run outside any manager or raceway.

label: Bundles strapped
instructions: Are visible cable bundles held together with straps or ties?
true_description: A visible bundle is held with velcro, straps, or ties.
false_description: Visible bundles are loose, with nothing holding the cables together.

label: Gentle bends
instructions: Do the visible cables bend in a smooth curve?
true_description: Visible bends are smooth curves.
false_description: A visible cable has a sharp crease or kink.

label: Power and data split
instructions: Do power cables and data cables follow separate paths where both are visible?
true_description: Power cables and data cables take different routes.
false_description: Power and data cables share the same bundle or path.

label: Connectors seated
instructions: Are the visible plugs fully inserted into their ports?
true_description: Visible plugs sit fully in their ports.
false_description: A visible plug is only partly inserted or is hanging out of its port.

label: Patch cords dressed
instructions: Do patch cords leave the panel along an orderly path?
true_description: Patch cords leave the panel in a combed or managed path.
false_description: Patch cords leave the panel in a tangled bunch.

label: Spare length managed
instructions: Is extra cable length coiled or strapped?
true_description: Spare cable length is coiled or strapped.
false_description: Spare cable length trails loose.

label: Loose cables on the floor
instructions: Are loose cables lying on the floor?
true_description: One or more cables lie loose on the floor.
false_description: The visible floor has no loose cables.

label: Hanging loops
instructions: Do cables hang in unmanaged loops across the front of the equipment?
true_description: Cables hang in unmanaged loops across the equipment face.
false_description: Cables do not hang in unmanaged loops across the equipment face.

label: Cables over intakes
instructions: Do cables lie across equipment air intakes or bezels?
true_description: Cables lie across an air intake or a bezel.
false_description: Air intakes and bezels are free of cables lying across them.

label: Blanking panels

true_description: Empty front rack units are covered by blanking panels.
false_description: An empty front rack unit is open, with no blanking panel.

label: Open front gaps

true_description: An open gap in the front face shows into or through the rack.
false_description: The front face is filled by equipment or blanking panels.

label: Intakes clear
instructions: Are the front air intakes free of paper, plastic, and boxes?
true_description: Front air intakes are uncovered.
false_description: Paper, plastic, or a box covers a front air intake.

label: Items stored in the rack
instructions: Are boxes, bags, or loose pieces of equipment stored in the rack opening?
true_description: A box, bag, or loose piece of equipment is stored in the rack opening.
false_description: The rack opening holds only mounted equipment.

label: Bezels installed
instructions: Are front bezels installed on the equipment?

false_description: An equipment front is missing its bezel.

label: Empty bays filled

false_description: The front door is a solid panel.

label: Side panel installed

false_description: The rack side is open, with the panel removed.

label: Rack ID label

false_description: No readable rack identification label is visible on the frame or header.

label: Unit labels

label: PDU label
